verdict.rationale: Anrok exposes a REST API (customers, transactions, filings, registrations, tax IDs) and markets 'Headless Tax' explicitly for agent use, plus an AI Atlas Q&A feature that reasons over registrations, filings, and certificates — but there is no evidence of a dedicated MCP server, scoped/agent-specific credentials, or a unified read surface combining nexus status, registrations, accrued liability, and filings in one call. missing for 10: documented MCP server or agent-scoped API keys, a single 'tax posture' read endpoint, and independent confirmation that agents can act (not just query) via these surfaces.
